## Policy, manuals, and past cases

### [doc:refund-and-credit-policy#late-delivery-credit] Refund and Credit Policy / Late delivery credit
If an order arrives more than 15 minutes after the promised time, the customer receives an automatic $5 SliceBot credit. If it arrives more than 45 minutes late, the credit is $10. Credits are applied to the customer's account and appear on the next order.
Key line: "If an order arrives more than 15 minutes after the promised time, the customer receives an automatic $5 SliceBot credit."

### [doc:refund-and-credit-policy#full-order-refunds] Refund and Credit Policy / Full order refunds
A full order refund is available when an order never arrives, or arrives more than 60 minutes late. Full refunds above $20.00 are always reviewed by a specialist, who confirms the delivery record before approving.
Key line: "A full order refund is available when an order never arrives, or arrives more than 60 minutes late."

### [doc:refund-and-credit-policy#automatic-approval-limits] Refund and Credit Policy / Automatic approval limits
An AI agent may approve a credit or refund of up to $20.00 per order without human review. Any single refund or credit above $20.00, or more than one refund on the same order, must be approved by a Customer Care specialist. Agents must never split a larger refund into smaller ones to stay under the limit.
Key line: "Any single refund or credit above $20.00, or more than one refund on the same order, must be approved by a Customer Care specialist."

### [doc:escalation-guidelines#what-a-good-handoff-contains] Escalation Guidelines / What a good handoff contains
A handoff must include the customer's request in one sentence, what was checked, what the agent recommends, and the policy that applies. The specialist should not need to ask the customer to repeat anything.

### [doc:identity-verification#what-unverified-contacts-can-get] Identity Verification / What unverified contacts can get
Unverified contacts may receive general information, such as policies, delivery areas, and product guidance. They must not be told account details, order contents, addresses, or payment information, and no credits, refunds, or account changes may be made.

## Limits that apply

- At most $20.00 back per order without a specialist; never split a refund to fit.
